verified.summary: Hands-on tests at the sauna over LAN (tinytuya, protocol 3.5). All writes are acknowledged with the new value.
verified.102_power: Plain on/off level, NOT a momentary toggle: writing true while already on leaves it on. Power on resets 105 to 80 min and sets 111 to White.
verified.101_heater: Plain on/off level, NOT a momentary toggle: writing true while already heating leaves it heating. Infrared panels give no visible cue; temperature rises ~1°F per 5-10 s.
verified.111_lights: Ignored while power is off (write acknowledged with no reply, value unchanged). With power on, colors and Off apply immediately.
verified.105_timer: Writable AND counts down while running, so it's both timer set and time remaining.
verified.108_current_f: Reported value is stale while power is off (read 156°F from an earlier session; jumped to the real 94°F on power on). Don't trust it while off.
verified.109_unit: true while the sauna uses °F; °C DPs (104, 106) are not reported in that mode.
verified.bluetooth: Not exposed over Tuya (2026-10-26): enabling BT streaming at the panel changed no DP and no hidden DP appeared during a 3-min read-only watch with updatedps. Can't be enabled remotely.
verified.panel_wake_quirk: When the heater was started remotely, waking the panel (long-press) showed heater in the OFF position and the wake/press turned DP101 off (and nudged 105 85->87). Owner had to switch heat back on at the panel. App/bridge may want to warn about this or re-assert heat.
